subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin expose both agent-facing `channel-info` and `channel-list` actions under the existing `channelInfo` capability, or should the project intentionally limit or separately gate Slack channel discovery?
rationale: The missing behavior is an optional new tool capability, and the only open candidate broadens scope to `search` and a new config flag while not implementing the requested metadata lookup.

options.title: Sponsor both actions under the existing gate
options.body: Implement `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` in the Slack plugin under the established `channelInfo` capability, with no unrelated search feature.

options.title: Adopt a narrower discovery contract
options.body: Approve only the action subset and output fields maintainers want to support, then track the remaining action explicitly.

options.title: Keep Slack discovery external
options.body: Decline a bundled agent action surface and document an extension or direct Slack API integration path instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor both actions under the existing gate
recommendation.body: Implement `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` in the Slack plugin under the established `channelInfo` capability, with no unrelated search feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work and review history cover the exact Slack action discovery, dispatch, runtime, and documentation boundary.
